description: The top-level keys of a rotator entry in a setup file, as imswitch.imcontrol.model.SetupInfo.DeviceInfo declares them. managerProperties is described per manager under managers/. Keys the dataclass does not declare are kept but not read.

analogChannel.description: Channel for analog communication. ``null`` if the device is digital or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/ao{analogChannel}".

digitalLine.description: Line for digital communication. ``null`` if the device is analog or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/port0/line{digitalLine}".

managerProperties.description: Properties to be read by the manager. Empty when omitted.

title: rotator device entry (DeviceInfo)
